eval.title: HPQ Stock Quick Take - Will the business grow?

call.headline_quote: hpq is definitely a contender because what I like about businesses I like that buying them at a fair cheap price but I also like that that in 10 years the business is likely to going to be bigger and better which gives me less risk a margin of safety and I'm looking forward to following hpq

base_metric.name: eps
base_metric.quote: the guidance going forward for the year it is around four dollars per share even for this year will likely be a little bit lower

what_is_priced_in.quote: the stock price is projecting fundamental deterioration in the future but how much is the question

reasons.claim: HPQ trades far below where Buffett bought his stake and at a low forward P/E, suggesting it is cheap.
reasons.quote: now the stock price is much lower and thus we can buy hpq at 30 percent lower price than what Warren Buffett paid

data_check.gap_note: he says 36, as-of 24.92 (2022-09-30); annual vs TTM or a different definition

reasons.claim: At around $4 EPS guidance and current price the forward P/E is around 10 with a strong free cash flow yield, which looks cheap if the business persists.
reasons.quote: if we go here times four that's around two free so I'm saying the p ratio should be around 10 2023

data_check.gap_note: he says 10, as-of 4.67542 (FY2021); annual vs TTM or a different definition; not in our data: eps guidance

reasons.claim: HPQ has taken on significant debt to fund buybacks at high prices, which he dislikes.
reasons.quote: there is significant gross debt that's something that is an issue of course they made an acquisition but we are now at 11 billion of debt and using that to do BuyBacks at a high stock price is something that I don't really like

data_check.gap_note: he says 1.1e+10, as-of 7.492e+09 (FY2021); annual vs TTM or a different definition

reasons.claim: Notebook demand pulled forward during the pandemic is likely to decline as the PC cycle normalizes.
reasons.quote: notebooks still a big deal this will inevitably get a hit likely in the next year or two but that's a given and that's normal cycle in the business

reasons.claim: Growth in video/audio conferencing gross margin could scale and improve the business, adding to its appeal as a durable ten-year holding.
reasons.quote: the gross margin for the audio and video conferences is there and if they can scale on that it is a very very interesting thing to have

data_check.gap_note: trajectory visible at T0; no number stated

external_facts_used: Warren Buffett bought 104 million HPQ shares at an average closing price of about $36
